shared_instructions: VC server-readiness review. Read-only: no edits, no commits, no server starts, no network writes. Never print secret values (env NAMES only). Cite file:line.

task.purpose: Owner asks: if this Node 20 + TypeScript pnpm monorepo is copied to a clean Ubuntu server with no Claude Code and started via the systemd unit (pnpm -C apps/api start = tsx src/main.ts), will it run or break, and why might it break on a server? Find every boot-time and first-request dependency that can fail.
acceptance: Verify the known traps with file:line: go-live gate reads repo-relative qa/gates/*.md at boot (apps/api/src/go-live-gate.ts; called at chat.ts:352, anonymous.ts:432, voice.ts:378) and needs VC_GATE_APPROVER, voice needs qa/evidence/p1-a10-diag/a10-diag-report.md; repo-relative skills/ (apps/api/src/index.ts:199) and config/sources.json (index.ts:546); tsx is a devDependency but start uses it.

Also look for: other repo-relative paths (import.meta.url, process.cwd), Windows-only assumptions (case-sensitive filenames on Linux, path separators, drive letters, .ps1), env vars that throw when missing (names only), hardcoded localhost upstreams (KB, Ollama, LiteLLM, Mongo), bind address/port vs nginx, workspace packages needing a build step (package.json main/exports pointing at dist), native deps, pnpm-workspace + lockfile, anything that spawns Claude Code or reads .claude/.

Return: verdict (runs as-is / runs with steps / will break), then failure modes ordered by likelihood, each with file:line, the symptom on the server, and the fix (code fix vs deploy step). Under 600 words.
checks: No edits, no server starts, no secret values.
